MPC post-run algorithm parameter summary
========================================

After an MPC run, the log now prints separate summaries of:
- effective HONU identification parameters,
- actual PCA reduction obtained during the run,
- online identification correction parameters,
- MPC horizon, optimizer settings, and objective weights,
- reference-model settings,
- initial-excitation settings and unrestricted-MPC-control note.

No identification or control equations were changed.
